description: This file defines a mock class 'EventThreadFactoryMock' implementing the 'IEventThreadFactory' interface, used for testing purposes within the 'firebolt::rialto::common' namespace. It includes a mock method 'createEventThread' that returns a unique pointer to an 'IEventThread' object, taking a thread name as input.

classes.name: EventThreadFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of IEventThreadFactory for testing, providing a mock method to create event threads.

methods.name: createEventThread
methods.description: Mock method to create an event thread, returning a unique pointer to IEventThread, given a thread name.
